notes.title: Bloody trains - released!
notes.notes:
Hi! 
This is marginal act with my new game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185000/Bloody_trains/]Bloody trains[/url]. Bloody trains is a sitcom train attendant simulator. In Bloody trains you will ride through a small country and take care about your passengers. They will get hungry, uncomfortable and cold. You’ll need to manage that parameters. 

Not all passengers are peaceful and you will need to fight dangerous people. For that you have blowing suitcases as part of indirect fight system. With suitcases you will fight terrorists and scary bosses!

Hope you’ll like my project
Thanks! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185000/Bloody_trains/

notes.title: TUTUTUTU - tea party is out! Welcome to the party!
Watching the woods
notes.notes:
This is a small update including new location - Woodcutter and some story details about Boris's childhood.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870431/b122467f2cdabeb2d28f1444dd528e8e83654ce4.gif[/img]
The main structure of this update is a small house for stuff near the hospice (main location). 
Boris will be able to visit sawmill - work place of his father and meet some scary flashbacks.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870431/9c5c63edc2d9be85dedea0e57a7e5573778d3704.png[/img]
This content will be available only after getting a pink key from big monster. 
Hope for your support.
Thanks!

notes.title: Level and collision update
notes.notes:
List of changes for the past week.
• The characteristics of the character's collision area changed, it is now longer and wider.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870431/f983bccbc159912a1fa7f49c88cf321c3039fb33.png[/img]
• The collision area is not reflected on the X axis when you rotate the hero.
• The walls around the stairs are cleaned and fused with common walls.
• A bug with a gas mask on fixed.
• Box collider on walls replaced by Polygons.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870431/2154286e40c253342dae0b312d79e6168ca026ba.png[/img]
